notes: CRM notes: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) — heavy EU user base, product team building an in-app assistant + document search and reranking for help flows. Started w/ Hosted API to iterate quickly; after early success they want Dedicated for predictable latency/cost and data residency. POC details: 2-week Dedicated node in eu-central + fallback to hosted in eu-west for overflow; test traffic synthetic + small real sample. Key ask: 'EU residency for data at rest + in-flight, and that logs / model cache don't leave region' (CTO). Latency target: <100ms P95 EU; current POC shows 120-150ms when cross-region fallback is enabled — SE suggests tuning batching KV cache and pinning heavy routes to eu-central. Cost sensitivity: mid (want price predictability). Finance asked for delta between hosted per-token vs Dedicated committed pricing and example unit economics for 500k tokens/day. Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logs, KMS integration mandatory; also asked about retention controls and ability to turn off third-party telemetry. Ops: want per-route rollout (canary + A/B) and model variant fallback (bigger -> smaller model when capacity constrained). Next steps: schedule Dedicated sizing call w/ infra + finance (AE + SE + finance), finalize EU residency SLA term, produce network/KMS diagram for security review, deliver revised pricing worksheet with 6/12 mo commit scenarios. Objections/blockers: need legal sign-off on residency clause and clearer latency SLA; uncertainty around multi-region failover behavior (tradeoffs: cost vs latency). AE notes: customer receptive to Optimize recommendations (batching/cache) to reduce unit cost — propose 30% cost savings example in deck. Short quotes: 'We love the latency control but need hard promises for EU data' — CTO; 'If Dedicated pricing aligns we can commit Q2' — Head of Product.
